# Contributing

Read https://github.com/Chitak985/ChitakTech/wiki/ChitakTech-for-modders before doing anything, it contains lots of important information.

## Mod Support
Explained on the wiki page but generally just tell me and I can add it. (or you can make a pull request to do so)

## New Features
This has to be confirmed with me since features are usually big.

## New Resources
If this is at least slightly realistic, I'm perfectly fine with it.

## New Parts
Like with resources, if it is at least slightly realistic, I'm fine with it.
